gloss: site area; lot area; total area of land on which a building stands

definitions.gloss: site area; lot area; total area of land on which a building stands
definitions.explanation: The total area of a piece of land (a building lot, factory site, school grounds, etc.), normally measured in square metres or {坪|つぼ} (a traditional unit of about 3.3 m²). A standard item in real-estate listings, building plans, and construction documents, often shown alongside the building footprint and total floor area.

examples.japanese: {敷地面積|しきちめんせき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧{平米|へいべい}だ。
examples.english: The site area is 100 square metres.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{敷地面積|しきちめんせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}する→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧。
examples.english: To make use of the large site area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{敷地面積|しきちめんせき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦ドーム→ドーム：24058_doomu⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧つ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相当|そうとう}する→相当する：21146_soutousuru⟧。
examples.english: The site area of the new factory is equivalent to about three Tokyo Domes.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{敷地|しきち}→敷地：00365_shikichi⟧ ('building site; plot of land') and ⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧ ('area'). One of the standard pieces of information given in any Japanese real estate or construction document.

USAGE:
- Standard real-estate listings show three areas: {敷地面積|しきちめんせき} (site area), ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧ (building footprint), and {延床面積|のべゆかめんせき} (total floor area, summed across all floors).
- Often expressed in {平米|へいべい} (m²) or ⟦{坪|つぼ}→坪：27977_tsubo⟧.
- ⟦{敷地|しきち}→敷地：00365_shikichi⟧ can refer to a residential lot, a school campus, a factory site, or a temple grounds; {敷地面積|しきちめんせき} is the area of any of these.
- The Japanese building code restricts the {建蔽率|けんぺいりつ} ('building-to-land ratio') and ⟦{容積率|ようせきりつ}→容積率：30020_yousekiritsu⟧ ('floor-area ratio') based on the {敷地面積|しきちめんせき}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敷地面積|しきちめんせき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧〜{平米|へいべい}: the site area is approximately ... square metres
- ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{敷地面積|しきちめんせき}: a large site area
- {敷地面積|しきちめんせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to secure (a sufficient) site area
- {敷地面積|しきちめんせき}⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧: per unit of site area
- {敷地面積|しきちめんせき}⟦{換算|かんさん}→換算：07992_kansan⟧: in terms of site area

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧: building (footprint) area — area covered by the building when seen from above.
- {延床面積|のべゆかめんせき}: total floor area — sum of floor areas across all storeys.
- ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧: land area — close synonym, sometimes used in surveying contexts.
- ⟦{敷地|しきち}→敷地：00365_shikichi⟧: building site; plot of land — the lot itself, without explicit reference to its area.
- {建蔽率|けんぺいりつ}: building-to-land ratio — the ratio of ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧ to {敷地面積|しきちめんせき}, used in building regulation.
